newsitem.title: USA: Prime Hospitality sells $200 mln 144A debt.
newsitem.headline: Prime Hospitality sells $200 mln 144A debt.

text.p: The following issue from Prime Hospitality Corp was priced in the 144A private placement market on Friday, according to a high-yield syndicate source.
Prime Hospitality Corp operates hotel chains including AmeriSuites.
BT Securities Corp was lead manager on the deal.
